corridors.name: Sol–Concord Corridor
corridors.description: Heavy commercial traffic, extensive support infrastructure, intense competition and predictable freight. Effectively an interstellar interstate.

corridors.name: Agricultural Loop
corridors.description: Food moves toward population and industry while machinery, technology and high-value goods move back.

corridors.name: Heavy Industrial Route
corridors.description: Ore and bulk resources move inward while machinery and industrial systems move outward. Large bulk carriers dominate.

corridors.name: Ocean Route
corridors.description: Biological products, food, chemicals and environmental technology. Specialized cargo is common.

corridors.name: Orun Industrial Route
corridors.description: Industrial components and thermal technology flow outward while food and biological goods flow back.

corridors.name: Frontier Run
corridors.description: The corridor where established commerce thins into frontier logistics and eventually unsupported exploration.

corridors.name: Ilyan Research Corridor
corridors.description: Instrument, sample and research-equipment traffic between Ilyan propulsion and survey industry, the Bradbury institutes and the Concord exchange. Modest volume, high value, tolerant of schedules but not of damage.
